description_en: Takes a Data Integration real-time synchronization task offline
description_zh: 下线数据集成实时同步任务
name: TerminateDISyncInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace used for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: DI_REALTIME indicates a real-time synchronization task
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The file ID of the real-time synchronization task
parameters.name: file_id

schema.description_en: The data structure returned for the real-time synchronization task
schema.description_zh: 实时同步任务返回的数据结构

Data.description_en: The status of taking the real-time synchronization task offline
Data.description_zh: 下线实时同步任务的状态

Message.description_en: The reason why the Data Integration real-time synchronization task fails to be taken offline. If the task is successfully taken offline, this parameter is empty
Message.description_zh: 下线数据集成实时同步任务失败后的原因描述。如果下线数据集成实时同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
The result status of taking the Data Integration real-time synchronization task offline. Valid values:

success: The Data Integration real-time synchronization task is successfully taken offline. 
fail: The Data Integration real-time synchronization task fails to be taken offline
Status.description_zh:
下线数据集成实时同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：

success：表示下线数据集成实时同步任务成功。 
fail：表示下线数据集成实时同步任务失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：

true：成功。
false：失败
